CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_shopper_quotes_enabled()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.pilot_feature_enabled('shopper_quotes') then
    raise exception 'Shopper quotes on custom requests are not part of the validation pilot.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_shopper_quote_acceptance_flag BEFORE UPDATE ON shopper_quotes FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.status = 'accepted'::shopper_quote_status AND old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'accepted'::shopper_quote_status) EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_shopper_quotes_enabled()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sourcing_board()
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, product_slug text, product_name text, variant_id uuid, variant_size text, variant_color text, variant_edition text, max_budget_cents integer, currency character, buyer_note text, needed_by date, quote_count integer, media_count integer, expires_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, my_quote_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$SELECT public.assert_current_account_access(); -- bluebird-account-boundary-v1

  SELECT r.id, p.slug, p.name, r.variant_id, v.size, v.color, v.edition,
         r.max_budget_cents, r.currency, r.buyer_note, r.needed_by,
         r.quote_count, r.media_count, r.expires_at, r.created_at,
         (SELECT q.id FROM public.shopper_quotes q
           WHERE q.request_id = r.id
             AND q.shopper_id = auth.uid()
             AND q.status IN ('submitted', 'accepted')
           LIMIT 1)
  FROM public.sourcing_requests r
  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = r.product_id
  JOIN public.product_variants v ON v.id = r.variant_id
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'shopper')
    AND r.status = 'open'
    AND NOT r.is_demo
    AND r.expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 100
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quotes_for_my_requests()
 RETURNS TABLE(quote_id uuid, request_id uuid, merch_cost_cents integer, shopper_comp_cents integer, shipping_estimate_cents integer, buyer_fee_estimate_cents integer, delivered_estimate_cents integer, currency character, availability_note text, fulfillment_window_days integer, expires_at timestamp with time zone, status shopper_quote_status, matched_order_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$SELECT public.assert_current_account_access(); -- bluebird-account-boundary-v1

  SELECT q.id, q.request_id, q.merch_cost_cents, q.shopper_comp_cents,
         q.shipping_estimate_cents, q.buyer_fee_estimate_cents,
         q.delivered_estimate_cents, q.currency, q.availability_note,
         q.fulfillment_window_days, q.expires_at, q.status, q.matched_order_id,
         q.created_at
  FROM public.shopper_quotes q
  JOIN public.sourcing_requests r ON r.id = q.request_id
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND r.buyer_id = auth.uid()
  ORDER BY q.delivered_estimate_cents ASC
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pilot_feature_enabled(_feature text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case _feature
           when 'custom_sourcing_requests' then s.custom_sourcing_requests_enabled
           when 'shopper_quotes' then s.shopper_quotes_enabled
           when 'live_checkout' then s.live_checkout_enabled
           else false
         end
  from public.market_settings s
  where s.id
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quotes_for_my_requests()
 RETURNS TABLE(quote_id uuid, request_id uuid, merch_cost_cents integer, shopper_comp_cents integer, shipping_estimate_cents integer, buyer_fee_estimate_cents integer, delivered_estimate_cents integer, currency character, availability_note text, fulfillment_window_days integer, expires_at timestamp with time zone, status shopper_quote_status, matched_order_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$SELECT public.assert_current_account_access(); -- bluebird-account-boundary-v1

  SELECT q.id, q.request_id, q.merch_cost_cents, q.shopper_comp_cents,
         q.shipping_estimate_cents, q.buyer_fee_estimate_cents,
         q.delivered_estimate_cents, q.currency, q.availability_note,
         q.fulfillment_window_days, q.expires_at, q.status, q.matched_order_id,
         q.created_at
  FROM public.shopper_quotes q
  JOIN public.sourcing_requests r ON r.id = q.request_id
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND r.buyer_id = auth.uid()
  ORDER BY q.delivered_estimate_cents ASC
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reservation_window()
 RETURNS interval
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$SELECT public.assert_current_account_access(); -- bluebird-account-boundary-v1

  SELECT CASE WHEN s.live_checkout_enabled
              THEN make_interval(mins => s.checkout_reservation_minutes)
              ELSE make_interval(mins => s.pilot_reservation_minutes)
         END
  FROM public.market_settings s WHERE s.id
$function$
